title: Hahn–Wilson thick generation at fp-type two
exact_target: For each prime p, must every connective p-complete spectrum of exact fp-type two lie in the thick subcategory generated by $BP\langle 2\rangle _p^\wedge $? The claimed counterexamples occur at every sufficiently large prime and also have $L_{2}^fX\simeq L_{2}X$ and $L_{T(2)}X\simeq L_{K(2)}X$.

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
